answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply sorts its findings into 'Fix before launch' (1-5), 'Accessibility problems to fix next' (6-9) and 'Smaller issues', and ends with 'Items 1–5 first ... Then 6–9'. It also says what it could not check: 'Everything below comes from the code, not from tapping through on a real phone. Please have someone do a quick check on an actual phone before launch, especially items 1 and 4', and it asks for the hard-coded date to be confirmed with the agency.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag has low contrast (3.0:1 light, 3.4:1 dark)
mapping.reason: This problem first appears in the intro ('dark mode passes contrast everywhere except one tag (item 9)') and is stated in full as item 9. The 'Few left' text falls below 4.5:1, which is the contrast defect.

mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: The review says there is no visible progress for 1.5 s and a second tap turns into a cancel, while the done page keeps the 'Booked' heading and the reference. That is exactly D09.

mapping.title: Five-minute hold never mentioned and runs out unseen
mapping.reason: The hold starts when a slot is tapped and is never shown. The resident only learns it lapsed after Book, from 'This slot is no longer available' with no link. That is the D08 harm.

mapping.title: Today opens by default and offers past or too-soon slots that are refused at the last step
mapping.reason: Same-day slots less than about 30 minutes ahead are shown and only rejected after all the details are typed. This is D06's offered-then-refused slots.

mapping.title: Today's date and the quick-day dates are hard-coded in the bundle
mapping.reason: The packet's own scenario fixes today as Monday 12 October, and the review itself assumes this is fixture data. It is a deployment check to confirm, not a usability problem the review shows in the flow.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' reset to Today and silently move the booking
mapping.reason: The slots page forgets the chosen day and slot and reopens on Today, so a re-pick lands on today. This is 'Change slot' forgetting the day.

mapping.title: Permit field appears late and unannounced; permit only checked on the confirm page, which has no field
mapping.reason: This covers the 1.2 s delayed permit field, Next accepting an empty permit, and the permit error on the confirm page with no field and no link back. All of these belong to D07.

mapping.title: No focus outline on slot buttons
mapping.reason: The injected `.slot:focus{outline:0}` rule removes the focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved out of time order to the top of the grid
mapping.reason: `order:-1` moves these slots above the Morning heading, so the visual order no longer matches keyboard and screen-reader order. This is D10.

mapping.title: Page scrolls sideways on 360 px phones
mapping.reason: At 360 px and below the script sizes the grid with fixed pixel columns that ignore the page padding, and the grid overflows the screen.

mapping.title: Slot grid empty for 0.9 s on a day change with no 'Loading slots…' message
mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: the grid is empty and nothing says slots are coming. That is D01's harm, even though the review does not mention Next doing nothing.

mapping.title: Status line only becomes a live region after the first load, so screen readers hear nothing
mapping.reason: aria-live is added only after the first write, so a screen reader is never told the slots have arrived. This is D11.

mapping.title: Vehicle-page error summary links point at non-focusable divs (#vehicle, #waste)
mapping.reason: When an error link targets a div that cannot take focus, keyboard and screen-reader users are not moved to the control they need to fix. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Confirm-page late errors (past slot, permit, centre closed) have no links to where they can be fixed
mapping.reason: Errors with no route to the fix leave residents stuck at the last step. The 'centre closed' error and the general lack of recovery links are not seeded, and adding links would not fix the core of D06 or D07, so it does not map to either.

mapping.title: Booking reference exists only on the done screen and in tab storage, not sent by text
mapping.reason: Residents must show the reference at the gate, and the centre has poor signal. Losing the tab loses the reference. This is a plausible harm, and D14 (missing day, slot and vehicle) does not cover it.

mapping.title: 'Reminder the evening before' promise doesn't apply to evening-before bookings
mapping.reason: Someone booking at 9 pm for the next morning has just seen their booking. The review shows no harm from the missing reminder beyond a wording nitpick.

mapping.title: Slot end time and 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
mapping.reason: This information sits only in the `title` tooltip, which never shows on phones. That is exactly D13.

mapping.title: Step list numbers read twice by screen readers (`<ol>` plus typed '1.')
mapping.reason: Screen-reader users hear duplicated numbers such as '1. 1. When'. It is a minor but genuine accessibility defect in how the steps are announced, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Waste hint not announced by screen readers
mapping.reason: The hint is attached to a plain div, so screen-reader users miss the guidance on what waste they can bring. This is a genuine, unseeded gap.

mapping.title: Registration field lacks autocapitalize="characters"
mapping.reason: This is an input-convenience suggestion. The review shows no harm, such as lowercase registrations being rejected or mismatched at the gate.

mapping.title: Theme colours set only by script; page unthemed if the script fails
mapping.reason: This is speculative and depends on a script failure, which would break the slot booking itself anyway. The review shows no harm to residents in the working flow.
